notes.title: Dungeons of Blood and Dream is a new psychedelic RPG with the best art style
notes.content:
Dungeon crawlers have had a long and storied history with PC gaming, from titles like Akalabeth, Eye of the Beholder, or Dungeon Master to more modern offerings like Dark and Darker, Dungeonborne, and Legend of Grimrock. There are some truly unique twists on the genre out there too, and Dungeons of Blood and Dream is one of them. Even outside of its art style, which is already enough to set it apart, it brings in some neat roguelike elements that make this entirely its own thing, and it's out now.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: 1.0 Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/76d714790826505fdb301e28a994ba86feb20786.png[/img]

It's been a wild 5 months or so since the early access release. I feel like the game has got to the point where I want it to be in terms of content, so I am thinking of pressing the release button next monday (11 November). There will probably be a small update accompanying it and the addition of collectible cards to the Steam page, but don't expect big changes in 1.0. 

1.0 is not the end and I will keep addressing bugs, performance and all other concerns. I am not going anywhere and will continue updating the game when required.

Thanks to everyone who supported the game so far! It's really come a long way, and it wouldn't be where it is now without everyone who played it during the early access!

notes.title: Dungeons of Blood and Dream will be available on May 27!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for wishlisting Dungeons. I am excited to announce that the game will be available here in Early Access on May 27. It will be fully playable from beginning till the end with several endings.

Really looking forward to hearing first pieces of feedback and continuing working on this game with your help! 

Make sure to let your friends know about this game, so they can wishlist it as well and make this release more visible in the store!
